definition: Star Schema Design is a core concept in Data Analytics. It refers to the techniques, principles and practices that let a practitioner work effectively with this topic in real systems.

theory.heading: What Star Schema Design is
theory.body: Star Schema Design describes the methods and patterns used within Data Analytics to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: Star Schema Design is a named, repeatable concept.
It has a clear purpose and scope.
It connects to other course topics.

theory.heading: Why Star Schema Design matters
theory.body: Without Star Schema Design, systems built with Data Analytics are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How Star Schema Design works
theory.body: The mechanism behind Star Schema Design follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of Star Schema Design.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Star Schema Design
theory.body: Star Schema Design offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
